# Sandwich Hedges

> Friendly, local hedge trimming and overgrown hedge rescue across Sandwich, Deal and the villages of East Kent. Free quotes, fair prices, tidy finish.

Sandwich Hedges is a UK hedge-trimming and overgrown-hedge-rescue service based in Sandwich, Kent. We cut every shape, height and species of garden hedge, from a quick annual tidy on a privet to a multi-day rescue of a leylandii that's run away. We quote every job individually after a quick look or a photo, and we stick to the number we give you. Always clear the cuttings.

## What we do

- **Annual hedge trim** - light cuts late May / early June, proper cuts from late August (after bird-nesting season ends).
- **Overgrown hedge rescue** - leylandii, conifer, laurel, beech reduced back to manageable size.
- **Reduction and shaping** - height drops, formal squaring-off, archway and gateway shaping.
- **Clippings clear-up** - sheets down, full rake, cuttings taken away. Garden left tidier than we found it.

## Service area

Sandwich, Deal, Worth, Ash, Woodnesborough, Eastry, Sandwich Bay and the East Kent villages within roughly ten miles of Sandwich.
